assertions: Real account connect persists a markup-shaped name as literal text and clears the credential input.
A reload renders the saved account name literally in the server-rendered and hydrated settings.
All seven delivery-log string fields remain literal text after a real default change refreshes the API resource; no payload elements or handlers appear.
Each of the three network choices retains its fixed local setup-document link.
A markup-shaped API error reaches FormError as literal text and a failed default mutation rolls back the optimistic checkbox.
